messages:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — we need a firm announce window for the marketplace listing + partner co-announcement. Legal wants signature before any external mention.
Kevin Patel: timeline check — external comms team aiming for a 2-week runway. can legal shorten review to 3 business days?
Sam (Legal): 3 biz days is tight. we can do 5 with a canned checklist. need final T&Cs + SI attachment by EOD Tue.
Alex Rivera: SI teams are still finalizing integration doc. ETA Wed for dev docs, Thu for partner-runbook. can we decouple announce from runbook release?
Maria Chen: yes — announce can go with a high-level blurb. but pricing/commit details must be final before listing. no ambiguity on discount tiers.
Kevin Patel: propose this cadence:
```
- Day 0: internal field freeze (pricing + SKUs)
- Day 2: legal review complete (contracts + partner clause)
- Day 3: marketing assets sign-off
- Day 7: external announce (soft) to marketplace first region
- Day 14: full public joint announce + SI enablement
```
Maria Chen: sounds reasonable. JuneBot, can you ping the marketplace liaisons for region staging availability? :pray:
JuneBot: @marketplace-liaison pinged — awaiting availability windows from AWS and GCP teams. ETA 24h. :robot_face:
Sam (Legal): also flag: renewal language needs clarity on how discounts step down after year 1. prefer explicit schedule in the private offer (example: 20% year1, 15% year2, 10% year3) otherwise renewal negotiations blow up.
Alex Rivera: SI feedback — they want a 60-day notice for deprecating any SKUs that affect private offers. add that to contract appendix?
Sam (Legal): yes, add appendix A: SKU deprecation & notice. I’ll draft and circulate.
Kevin Patel: ops question — if a customer signs before the announce window (pre-sign with partner), do we allow early activation or hold until list?
Maria Chen: allow activation but mark as "private agreement — not listed". marketing shouldn't post anything until Day 7.
Alex Rivera: can we add an opt-in migration credit (one-time) to encourage early activation? e.g., $X credit if they convert to listed SKU within 90 days.
Sam (Legal): need to cap credits in contract and ensure they're treated as discounts not service credits. avoids accounting headaches.
Kevin Patel: will draft a sample credit clause and share.
JuneBot: reminder scheduled: Legal review due 1753300000 (in 24h).
Maria Chen: thanks — action items: Kevin drafts credit clause, Alex finalizes runbook decoupling plan, Sam drafts appendix + T&Cs, JuneBot confirms region windows. we'll reconvene tomorrow 11am PT. :calendar:
